section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses employed in the study, including confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) using WLSMV estimation with polychoric correlations. The text outlines procedures for testing measurement invariance across gender and weight status, assessing internal reliability via composite reliability, examining temporal stability, and investigating gender and weight status differences through a MIMIC model. No specific study numbers, sample characteristics, or empirical results are provided in this methodological section.
